supporting_pages.title: "Compare global and regional service \_|\_ Secret Manager \_|\_ Google Cloud\
evidence_snippets: For organizations with stringent data sovereignty and compliance requirements, Secret Manager offers a regional service where you can choose to store your data solely within specific geographical locations or data residency zones (DRZs).
This page explains the key differences between the global and regional service of Secret Manager.
